backend.description: The database backend type: memfile, mysql, or pgsql.

command.description: The kea-admin command to execute: db-init, db-version, db-upgrade, lease-dump, lease-upload, or stats-recount.

database_name.description: Name of the database to connect to.

extra_args.description: Extra arguments to pass to the database command tool (e.g., --ssl). Items are strings.

host.description: Hostname when connecting to the database.

input_file.description: CSV file with leases to be uploaded (required for lease-upload).

ip_version.description: IP version flag for lease dump/upload: 4 or 6.

items.description: Placeholder for list items in extra_args

output_file.description: File to which lease data will be dumped (required for lease-dump).

password.description: Password when connecting to the database. If empty, KEA_ADMIN_DB_PASSWORD env var is used or prompt occurs.

port.description: Port when connecting to the database. Defaults to client default if not specified.

script_directory.description: Override scripts directory used during upgrades/initialization.

username.description: Username when connecting to the database.

yes.description: Assume yes on overwriting temporary files.
